summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting an ordinary registered direct offering of Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants under an existing shelf registration statement. The offering raised approximately $2.0 million in gross proceeds at $1.50 per share/warrant, closed June 15, 2026, with net proceeds for working capital. D. Boral Capital acted as placement agent for an 8% cash fee. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No category applies.
